parsed.explanation: A latent trans-relevant criminal offence — a male 'deception as to his true sex' public-solicitation provision — sits in the same code as an unenforced 10-year sodomy clause; no enforcement of either is documented, so this is a law-on-the-books exposure of unknown reach. No legal gender recognition, no anti-discrimination or hate-crime protection, and no documented police response to anti-LGBTQ violence leave a hostile record with no recourse; a 2021 activist murder and a documented climate of fear under rising fundamentalism make everyday hostility the main traveller-facing risk. Offsetting this: no documented border screening, stops, detention or prosecution of trans travellers, and an embedded indigenous third-gender role that normalises gender diversity. Border practice and how the deception clause is applied are the decisive unknowns.

entry_documents.exposure: No legal gender recognition; visitor documents carry birth-sex marker and no local procedure can change it. No sourced information on border or airport screening of trans travellers.
entry_documents.protection: Not documented. Judicial code of conduct binds judges only.
entry_documents.interaction: A document mismatch is presented to border officers whose discretion is wholly undocumented; no appeal or overlay remedy is described.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: A criminal provision reaches a male who solicits in public for an immoral purpose with intent to deceive as to his true sex, which can be turned on visible presentation. No documented arrests, custody or prison-placement practice.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Offence unenforced on the record; if invoked, no documented counsel, consular, or complaint route is described.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No documented bathroom, ward, shelter, or housing rule reaching trans visitors; one national criminal code, no mapped local variation.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Resident shelter infrastructure is a single facility damaged by a 2018 cyclone, so any community support is national in effect and thin.

care_services.exposure: No anti-discrimination law in provision of goods and services; no documented refusal of care to visitors, but no recourse if refused.
care_services.interaction: Without enforceable standards, a clerk or clinician's discretion is the only controlling factor.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: State has made no commitment to the UN SOGI statement; the code retains a deception-based public-morality offence and a 10-year sodomy clause, both unrepealed. Rising fundamentalism increases hostility toward gender-nonconforming people.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: None documented; no hate-crime or sentencing protection for anti-LGBTQ violence.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: No documented enforcement either way, so the state reads as a bystander whose law encodes the hostility rather than countering it.

minors_guardians.exposure: A visibly trans minor travelling with a guardian faces the same undocumented border check and the same deception provision; no schooling, care, or facility rule for minors is documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: No documented procedure for a mismatched guardian/minor pair; the parent carries the only document.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: An LGBTQ activist was murdered near his home in 2021; a documented climate of fear, discrimination and homophobia is reported, with no hate-crime statute and no sourced police response.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Not documented. No hate-crime or bias-sentencing provision identified.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: A single dated incident plus a documented attitudinal pattern; no evidence of investigation, prosecution or public response, so impunity is unresolved rather than established.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No anti-discrimination law, no relationship recognition, no hate-crime recourse, no documented complaints mechanism reaching visitors. Official guidance exists only for travellers generally.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Judicial code of conduct (2010) bars bias by judges alone; no enforcement record.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: The only documented oversight binds judges, not police, border officers, landlords or service providers.

anchor_checks.comparison: Vellandra documents a routine, universally applied border exclusion with unpublished criteria and no effective remedy. This dossier documents no such enforcement machinery at all, so the concrete probability of a traveller-facing sanction is lower; it rates above that anchor despite a criminal rather than purely administrative exposure.

Kestrel Isles documents actual secondary screening, luggage searches and discretionary refused admission for document mismatch. Here border practice is entirely undocumented, but a latent criminal presentation provision and a documented hostile climate with no recourse sit below that anchor's administrative, appealable framework.

Meridia trains border officers, recognises matching markers, provides written reasons, counsel and a tribunal with compensation. None of that appears here; the gap is a full tier and a half, not a nuance.

Vesskar documents routine verification checks, detention, humiliation and care denial under a deception statute, plus a narrow anti-discrimination claim. This dossier has the comparable statute but no documented stops or denials, and an embedded third-gender tradition instead of a court remedy — near-equivalent overall, slightly below.

parsed.synthesis: The operative risk is a latent, unenforced trans-relevant criminal provision combined with a state that offers no protection of any kind and a documented climate of hostility toward gender-nonconforming people, punctuated by a 2021 activist murder with no recorded official response. Against that, no source documents a single border stop, police check, detention or prosecution of a trans traveller, and the indigenous third-gender role means visible gender difference is culturally familiar rather than automatically read as fraud. Because outed exposure is undocumented, the rating rests on the possibility carried by the statute, not on observed enforcement: below the administrative-screening tier, above the routine-exclusion tier.
